newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital set new annualized dividend.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital set new annualized dividend.

text.p: Security Capital Pacific Trust said on Wednesday its board of trustees set a new annualized dividend level for 1997 of $1.30 per common share or $0.325 per quarter.
The board also declared the company's first quarter 1997 dividend of $0.325 per common share. The dividend is payable on Feb 20 1997 to shareholders of record on Feb 7 1997.
The company's previous quarterly dividend was $0.31 per common share.
Security Capital is a real estate operating company which focuses on the development, acquisition, operation and long-term ownership of multifamily properties in markets in the western United States.
